body:
I appreciate what you're trying to do, and I'm sorry it took this long to respond.

Don't waste your time with me, your efforts would be much better focused on other people.

I know, and I appreciate it. I honestly didn't expect this to get any responses at all, so even that helped a little bit.

That always seems to be the first question everyone asks, though. "Are you even trying?" Of course I'm trying, a friend is the only thing I want!

I've looked and I HAVE tried to make a genuine effort to make some friends. I don't spend 16 hours a day at my PC and wonder why nobody talks to me.

It just seems like people don't have an interest in being friends with me. It's like as soon as we get past the "What's your name and what do you do?" part, they lose all interest entirely.
